purpose: Define SAFOR Memory as provider-neutral durable project state that can be shared across humans, sessions and LLMs without depending on a specific repository product.

sharedTeamAdditionalRequirement.rule: SHARED_TEAM mode is forbidden unless shared access and a proven multi-writer concurrency mechanism exist.

providerTypes.description: Any provider-backed versioned artifact repository whose adapter proves the mandatory memory capabilities.
A host-provided durable filesystem location. Eligibility requires proof that data survives chat/session restart and can be reopened.
A future or organization-specific memory provider implementing the SAFOR Memory Provider Adapter contract.

selectionPolicy.failureRule: Lack of GitHub/GitLab is not a blocker. Lack of any provider that can prove durable read/write/resume semantics is a blocker.

ownership.rule: The model may access SAFOR Memory only through verified permissions; it never owns or becomes the authoritative holder of project state.

authoritativeStatePolicy.rule: No later action may rely on a project fact that exists only in chat context.

concurrency.rule: Concurrent sessions reload authoritative memory after conflicts and never overwrite unseen state.

resume.rule: A fresh chat must be able to reconstruct actionable project state from SAFOR Memory plus pinned product packages.

provenance.modelDataRule: Record only model/provider/version data actually exposed by the host. Unknown values must remain null with observability NOT_EXPOSED; never invent model identity.
